faq.q: What is the origin of Zaki?
faq.a: Zaki is associated with Arabic. Zaki is Arabic زَكِيّ (Zakī), meaning 'pure, virtuous'.
Yes — the underlying form زَكِي is Arabic.
Zaki can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Zaki should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Zakī is not a Quranic personal name.
